risks.independent_test_and_fix_status: `test_o01_mixed_terminal_nan_blocks_unrelated_live_row`. Reproduced, **NOT_FIXED**. This is fail-closed batch availability and reset-isolation failure, not unsafe returned control. Later accessor masking must preserve whitelist and live-row validation.

risks.counterexample_or_limit: Masking env0 changes env1's Monte Carlo path despite identical env1 input digest and generator seed. Identical local seed is insufficient for paired exogenous randomness under asynchronous terminations.
risks.independent_test_and_fix_status: `test_o02_other_terminal_mask_reassigns_live_env_samples`. Reproduced, **NOT_FIXED**. All candidates within one call still share paths correctly; no global RNG is used. Per-env streams/counters and matched-reset tests require an approved integration design.

An independent 18 m on-axis sphere has 0 pixels at160×90 and4 at320×180, crossing the real2-pixel gate; primary area using the old `fx` remains below2. Defaults have equal resolutions; no claim that frozen P03 used a decoupled setting. **NOT_FIXED**; changing the explicitly approved whitelist/priors requires review.
